call_sites: scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:2 (hook_root resolution; invoked by git as the pre-commit hook through core.hooksPath=scripts/git-hooks)

findings.text: follow-on: the shim resolves hook_root to the checkout that contains the hook file (realpath -e of $0, then its directory's parent twice via cd/pwd -P), so it still requires that checkout to carry .venv and an importable nova package. A linked worktree created without the symlinked .venv fails exactly as the base did (python not found), but nova's worktree-provisioning rule supplies the symlink and the new test mirrors it by symlinking .venv and nova into the scratch worktree, so this is a coupling to the provisioning rule rather than a defect in the fix. Recorded so the requirement is explicit: the shim's correctness is coupled to the .venv symlink, not to git resolving the checkout itself.

item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is the §6 follow-on that the commit hook refuses every worktree commit; the base shim resolved hook_root with `git -C dirname(realpath -e -- $0) rev-parse --show-toplevel`, which under a hook returns the hooks directory, so <root>/.venv/bin/python3 did not exist and every linked-worktree commit was refused. The fix at scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:2 resolves the root from the script path alone.

justifications.durability: tests/test_commit_hook_in_worktree.py exercises the defect end to end in real scratch repositories, from both the primary checkout and a linked worktree, covering a clean commit admitted and a worktree-path file refused (4 arms); the linked-worktree refusal arm asserts the offending filename appears, which discriminates a real refusal from the base hook's python-not-found error, so the regression guard is genuine rather than shape-matching. The review could not re-run the arms in its fenced tree, which is the only reason this is not 20.
justifications.evidence: the added-failure count is 0, read from the reviewed run's own gate.log (4 passed, EXIT=0, head hook) and negative_control.log (2 failed/2 passed, EXIT=1, base hook, failing exactly the two linked-worktree arms); this review independently reproduced the base defect read-only (a hook-like GIT_DIR makes `git -C <hooks-dir> rev-parse --show-toplevel` return the hooks directory) and ran the fixed hook's payload (relativize --check) against the clean head tree (EXIT=0), both in review-mechanism.log.
justifications.fit: the shim stays a POSIX-sh shim and resolves its root purely by path (realpath -e, then cd/pwd -P), which matches nova's worktree-provisioning rule (a symlinked .venv per ~/.agents and nova AGENTS.md); the test follows the repo's pytest idiom (tmp_path scratch repos, Path, subprocess) and imports the shared WORKTREE_ROOT constant.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node goal — a commit shim that finds its own checkout so a linked worktree admits a clean commit and refuses a worktree path — is met: scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:2 no longer consults git for its root, and the head arm passes while the base arm fails on the two worktree arms; the only residual is that the shim still needs a provisioned .venv (recorded as a follow-on, not a defect).
justifications.reuse: no new abstraction is introduced: the shim keeps the existing `nova.database.scripts relativize --check` payload, and the test composes its offending path from the shared WORKTREE_ROOT constant instead of a literal, so the guard keeps one decision.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path changed by the diff (git diff --stat 1c023858f a8ec8e507: scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit, tests/test_commit_hook_in_worktree.py, docs/evidence/fragments/artifacts-carry-no-worktree-paths/acnwp-hook-worktree-root.html) is inside the manifest's declared write paths.

limitations: The four-arm pytest was not re-run end to end by this review: the reviewer's worktree is fenced, so a scratch `git init`/`commit` run from the test is refused before it reaches the hook (review-head-arm.log shows 4 failed on scaffolding), and that re-run is not a valid arm. The gate result is read from the reviewed run's own gate.log (4 passed EXIT=0) and negative_control.log (2 failed/2 passed EXIT=1).

The head arm's gate.log header records revision 1c023858f (the worktree base) while the tree it exercised is the head worktree (its module_under_test and rootdir name the a8ec8e507 worktree); the header revision does not name the head commit.

The base-hook defect was reproduced read-only by setting GIT_DIR and observing rev-parse return the hooks directory, rather than by invoking scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit end to end through a real commit.
